title: noc-e2e screenshots now fire BEFORE EndDrawing despite comments claiming after-flush
detail: EndDrawing moved after the noc-e2e TakeScreenshot block. The retained comment warns mid-frame screenshots miss the unflushed rlgl batch; the new comment's after-flush claim is false.
recommended_fix: Run the noc-e2e capture block after the new explicit EndDrawing (or inside a post-flush path) so screenshots happen after the flush in both modes.

title: Fail-loud font validity check can never fire: load_font_file already substituted the raylib default
detail: On a failed load, load_font_file returns GetFontDefault(), which passes IsFontValid. The 'refusing to run with the raylib default' guards in main/goldens are unreachable; the silent fallback persists.
recommended_fix: Make load_font_file/load_fonts report failure (invalid font or a failed flag) instead of substituting GetFontDefault, and have the guards test that.

title: glyph_probe maps codepoints to glyphs by index, contradicting the compaction rule documented in the same diff
evidence:
+	for i in 0..<n {
+		cp := cps[i]
+		g := f.glyphs[i]
+		present := g.advanceX > 0 || (g.image.width > 0 && g.image.height > 0)
+// APPEND the glyphs. raylib COMPACTS the glyph array (missing codepoints are
+// skipped; the atlas lookup maps by glyph.value, never by index — appended
detail: If the probed font lacks a codepoint — the exact case the probe exists to detect — the compacted array is shorter and misaligned: wrong verdicts plus an out-of-bounds f.glyphs read.
recommended_fix: Look up glyphs by glyph.value as font_test.odin's font_probe_warning does; bound iteration by the loaded glyph count, not the requested count.

title: font_merge_fallback leaks the fallback glyph array block (fg)
evidence:
+	fg := rl.LoadFontData(raw_data(fdata), c.int(len(fdata)), size,
+		raw_data(missing[:missing_n]), c.int(missing_n), .DEFAULT, &ng)
+	rl.MemFree(glyphs) // the block is free; the glyph image data lives on in merged
+	return merged, total
detail: Only the main array (glyphs) is MemFree'd; the fallback array block fg is never freed, contradicting the adjacent 'UnloadFont owns every byte' claim.
recommended_fix: rl.MemFree(fg) after copying its entries into merged (and on the merged==nil early-return path).

title: missing[8] cap silently drops missing codepoints beyond eight
detail: A font lacking more than eight requested codepoints silently keeps the rest missing — contrary to the fail-loud policy this diff claims elsewhere.
recommended_fix: Assert or log loudly when missing_n saturates at len(missing) instead of silently skipping the overflow.
